（zoom）.on('dblclick.zoom',null)}
function addDragon(g,projection){const p=projection([-151,-28]);const d=g.append('g').attr('class','dragon-map').attr('transform',`translate(${p[0]} ${p[1]}) scale(.72)`).attr('aria-hidden','true');d.append('text').attr('text-anchor','middle').attr('y',-69).text('Here be bookwyrms');d.append('path').attr('class','fill').attr('d','M-58 47c21-6 39-2 58 12 19-14 37-18 58-12l-3 17C35 60 19 64 0 72c-19-8-35-12-55-8z');d.append('path').attr('d','M0 59v13M-50 52c18-2 34 2 50 14M50 52C32 50 16 54 0 66');d.append('path').attr('class','fill').attr('d','M-6 46c-11-5-16-16-15-27 1-12 9-18 14-27 6-11 2-22 11-31 6-5 14-7 21-3 6 3 9 9 8 15-1 5-4 8-9 11 2 8 0 16-6 22-5 4-7 9-5 15 2 8 8 14 16 16-8 6-23 10-35 9z');d.append('path').attr('d','M12-39l5-9 4 10M26-38l8-4-3 8M23-28c-4-1-7 0-9 3M25-23l10 2-10 3');d.append('path').attr('class','fill').attr('d','M-7 3C-20-8-34-10-48-6c10 4 16 10 19 18-8 1-14 5-19 11 15-1 28 4 38 15zM11 0c11-11 23-15 37-12-8 5-13 11-16 19 8 1 14 3 20 9-14 1-25 6-34 16z')}
function addCompass(svg){const c=svg.append('g').attr('class','compass').attr('transform','translate(1125 555)');c.append('circle').attr('r',34);c.append('circle').attr('r',27);c.append('path').attr('d','M0-44 7-9 0 0-7-9ZM0 44 7 9 0 0-7 9ZM-44 0-9 7 0 0-9-7ZM44 0 9 7 0 0 9-7Z');c.append('line').attr('x1',0).attr('y1',-27).attr('x2',0).attr('y2',27);c.append('line').attr('x1',-27).attr('y1',0).attr('x2',27).attr('y2',0);c.append('text').attr('x',0).attr('y',-49).attr('text-anchor','middle').text('N')}
function resetMap(){if(zoom)els.map.transition().duration(500).call(zoom.transform,d3.zoomIdentity);hideTooltip(true);closeSheet()}
async function refresh({quiet=false}={}){if(!quiet)setStatus('Checking the live reading ledger…');try{const rows=await loadSheet();buildGroups(rows);const time=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}).format(new Date());setStatus(`Live sheet · checked ${time}`,'live')}catch(err){console.error(err);setStatus('Live sheet unavailable · try reloading','error');if(!books.length)els.summary.textContent='The reading ledger could not be opened'}finally{els.loading.hidden=true}}
async function init(){try{setStatus('Loading the world map…');const [world,flagRows]=await Promise.all([fetch(WORLD_URL).then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Map data failed');return r.json()}),fetch(FLAGS_URL).then(r=>r.ok?r.json():[]).catch(()=>[])]);flagRows.forEach(row=>flags.set(norm(row.name),row.emoji));flags.set('united states of america','🇺🇸');flags.set('united kingdom','🇬🇧');flags.set('south korea','🇰🇷');flags.set('ivory coast','🇨🇮');drawMap(world);await refresh();setInterval(()=>refresh({quiet:true}),REFRESH_MS);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible')refresh({quiet:true})})}catch(err){console.error(err);setStatus('The atlas could not be loaded','error');els.loading.innerHTML='<div><strong>The atlas could not be unrolled.</strong><p>Please reload the page.</p></div>'}}
document.querySelector('#zoomIn').onclick=()=>zoom&&els.map.transition().call(zoom.scaleBy,1.55);document.querySelector('#zoomOut').onclick=()=>zoom&&els.map.transition().call(zoom.scaleBy,1/1.55);document.querySelector('#reset').onclick=resetMap;document.querySelector('#logoReset').onclick=resetMap;document.querySelector('#tooltipClose').onclick=()=>hideTooltip(true);document.querySelector('#sheetClose').onclick=closeSheet;els.backdrop.onclick=closeSheet;els.tooltip.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>clearTimeout(hideTimer));els.tooltip.addEventListener('pointerleave',scheduleHide);addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){hideTooltip(true);closeSheet()}});init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
